title: Patagonia Full Circuit
excerpt: Eighteen days traversing the raw southern edge of the continent — granite towers, grinding glaciers, and windswept steppe.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Punta Arenas
itinerary.description: Transfer to Torres del Paine. Acclimatize, gear check, team briefing over a shared asado.

itinerary.title: W Trek Begin — Lago Grey
itinerary.description: First full day hiking toward Glacier Grey. Blue ice calving into the lake, wind from the Southern Ice Field.

itinerary.title: Paso John Gardner
itinerary.description: The high pass connecting the W Trek to the O Circuit. Full view of the ice field on clear days.

itinerary.title: Remote Campsite — Río de los Perros
itinerary.description: Isolated valley. No other trekkers. Wild camping by a glacial river with guanacos on the opposite bank.

itinerary.title: Seron & Dickson
itinerary.description: Long valley traverse. Rheas and flamingos in the lowland wetlands. Estancia Dickson for resupply.

itinerary.title: Los Cuernos
itinerary.description: The horns of Torres del Paine at sunset — iron-stained igneous peaks catching last light in rust and gold.

itinerary.title: Mirador Las Torres
itinerary.description: 4am alpine start. The granite towers at sunrise. Silence except for wind and distant rock fall.

itinerary.title: Rest Day — Puerto Natales
itinerary.description: Gear dry-out. Debrief. Optional kayak in the fjord.

itinerary.title: Transfer to El Calafate
itinerary.description: Border crossing into Argentina. Patagonian steppe. Condors overhead.

itinerary.title: Perito Moreno Glacier
itinerary.description: Stand on the glacier. Hear it move. Ice trekking with crampons through a blue-white labyrinth.

itinerary.title: Los Glaciares Sector Sur
itinerary.description: Remote southern section of the national park. No crowds. Camping below Cerro Torre.

itinerary.title: Fitz Roy Massif
itinerary.description: Classic approach to Laguna de los Tres. Fitz Roy at close range — arguably the most beautiful mountain on earth.

itinerary.title: El Chaltén Village
itinerary.description: Argentina's trekking capital. Microbreweries, wood-fired kitchens, climbers studying route topos.

itinerary.title: Carretera Austral North
itinerary.description: Drive north into Chile's scenic highway. Hanging glaciers drip into roadside rivers.

itinerary.title: Cochrane & Baker River
itinerary.description: Wild swimming in the turquoise Baker — the Patagonian river no one talks about.

itinerary.title: Corcovado Wilderness
itinerary.description: Rarely visited rainforest. Inland navigation by zodiac. Volcanic activity visible from camp.

itinerary.title: Final Camp
itinerary.description: Last night in the field. Stars from horizon to horizon. No light pollution in any direction.

included: Experienced OVERLAND lead guide + local specialist
All meals from Day 1 dinner through Day 18 breakfast
Group camping equipment (tents, sleeping mats, cooking gear)
All park entrance fees (Torres del Paine, Los Glaciares)
Internal transfers and border crossing logistics
Daily briefings and printed route notes
gear: Hardshell jacket + trousers (Patagonia wind is serious)
